verdict.rationale: Wise Business does provide 'global account details' for receiving payments (wise-docs-9), which implies access to account/routing numbers, but there's no evidence of a dedicated bank verification letter feature. More critically, community reports show account/routing details changing abruptly without notice (wise-comm-2, wise-comm-3, wise-comm-5), undermining the 'anytime' reliability a finance-lead would need for verification purposes.
